@graph.comment: OperationsIndexListener (D112 §5) — subscribes to MonitoringStore 'changed' events, watches .operations/ ledger containers, and derives mem:hasOpenAction back-pointers: when a mem:RealignAction with PotentialActionStatus is created, writes <target> mem:hasOpenAction <proposal-url> into the target's .meta; on status flip to Completed/Failed or Delete, removes the pointer. Server-derived (floor/loop rule: inferable state). Re-entrancy guard mirrors IdCatalogStore. KNOWN LIMIT: Delete-removal relies on in-memory seen-map — a restart between Create and Delete leaves a dangling pointer (FOLLOWUPS). K1 note: this listener is wired into the WorkerParallelInitializer Override in mem-trigger.json (which holds the single K1-compliant consolidation point for all listener handlers).
